marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF513EB cordless ratchet features a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor and offers up to 70 ft-lb of torque, making it suitable for fastening and removing tough bolts. With a variable speed trigger and a speed rating of 250 RPM, this tool helps maximize productivity. Its glass-filled nylon housing provides durability and the long neck design allows for efficient access in tight spaces.
